name: OpenStreetMap
description: Collaborative world map project maintaining a free, editable database of streets, buildings, land use, and natural features built by volunteers.
attribution_requirements: Credit OpenStreetMap contributors when using OSM data.

name: The National Map
description: USGS program for topographic information in the United States, offering viewers, services, and downloads for elevation, hydrography, boundaries, and imagery.

name: Natural Earth
description: Public domain map dataset with cultural, physical, and raster layers at several scales, designed for cartographic use and supported by NACIS volunteers.

name: GeoNames
description: Worldwide geographical database of place names with coordinates, administrative hierarchy, alternate names, and free web services for lookup tasks.

name: Ordnance Survey
description: National mapping agency for Great Britain providing open and commercial map products, address data, and developer APIs for England, Scotland, and Wales.
status_notes: Open products are free to use; premium products and some APIs require payment.

name: IGN France
description: French national institute for geographic and forest information, publishing maps, aerial imagery, elevation models, and open datasets for France.
publisher: Institut national de l'information geographique et forestiere (IGN)

name: TIGER/Line Shapefiles
description: US Census Bureau geospatial extract of roads, water features, and legal and statistical boundaries, published as shapefiles and geodatabases each year.

name: OpenAddresses
description: Open collection of worldwide address point data aggregated from national, state, and municipal government sources with per source licence notes.
status_notes: Licences vary by contributing source; check each source entry before reuse.

name: GADM
description: Global database of administrative areas for all countries, offering multiple boundary levels as shapefiles and other formats for mapping and analysis.
status_notes: Downloads are free; the site states terms restricting commercial use and redistribution.

name: NationalMap
description: Australian government map based tool for exploring and visualizing open geospatial data published by federal, state, and territory agencies.

name: Overture Maps Foundation
description: Consortium project under the Linux Foundation publishing open map datasets that combine member and community inputs in versioned schema releases.

name: OpenAerialMap
description: Open archive of aerial and satellite imagery contributed by mapping organizations and volunteers, browsable on a map for humanitarian and community use.
status_notes: Imagery licences are set by each contributing provider.

name: Nominatim
description: Open source geocoding engine for OpenStreetMap data, providing address search and reverse geocoding through a documented HTTP API.
status_notes: The public instance enforces a usage policy; self hosting is allowed.

name: Geofabrik OpenStreetMap Extracts
description: Download service offering regional OpenStreetMap data extracts for continents, countries, and regions, updated regularly and licensed under ODbL.
attribution_requirements: Credit OpenStreetMap contributors under ODbL terms.

name: Geographic Names Information System
description: USGS gazetteer of official names and locations for geographic features in the United States, searchable online with downloadable files.

name: Landsat Missions
description: Joint USGS and NASA program site documenting the Landsat satellite series and the longest continuous record of global land observation from space.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
description: Access point for Copernicus Sentinel satellite data with browsing, openEO and OData services, and processing tools for European Union Earth observation data.

name: NASA Earthdata
description: NASA portal for Earth science data, connecting distributed archives of atmospheric, land, ocean, and cryosphere products with search and access services.

name: Worldview
description: Interactive browser for near real time and historical global satellite imagery from NASA Earth observing instruments, with image export and layer controls.

name: Observing the Earth
description: European Space Agency section on Earth observation describing ESA satellite missions, applications, and news about monitoring the planet.

name: EarthExplorer
description: USGS search and order tool for satellite and aerial data, including Landsat scenes, elevation products, and declassified imagery, with free account access.

name: EUMETSAT
description: European meteorological satellite agency operating geostationary and polar orbiting satellites and providing weather and climate data services.
publisher: European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites

name: G-Portal
description: JAXA satellite data archive for searching and downloading Earth observation products from Japanese missions, including precipitation and ocean datasets.

name: NASA Common Metadata Repository
description: NASA metadata system and API that indexes Earth science datasets across EOSDIS data centers, supporting programmatic search of satellite and model holdings.

name: Google Earth Engine
description: Cloud platform combining a large catalog of satellite imagery and geospatial datasets with parallel processing and JavaScript and Python APIs.
status_notes: Noncommercial research use requires registration; commercial use is billed.

name: LandsatLook
description: USGS viewer for discovering, previewing, and downloading Landsat scenes and surface reflectance products with map based search.

name: NASA Earth Observatory
description: NASA publication presenting satellite imagery and explanatory articles on climate, land, oceans, and human activity for public understanding.

name: NASA
description: Website of the United States National Aeronautics and Space Administration with mission pages, imagery, science news, and program documentation.

name: ESA
description: Website of the European Space Agency covering space science, exploration, Earth observation, launchers, and agency activities across member states.

name: SIMBAD Astronomical Database
description: CDS database of identifications, measurements, and bibliography for astronomical objects beyond the solar system, queryable by name, coordinates, and filters.
publisher: Centre de Données astronomiques de Strasbourg (CDS)

name: VizieR
description: CDS catalogue service hosting published astronomical tables and catalogues with column level queries and links back to journal articles.
publisher: Centre de Données astronomiques de Strasbourg (CDS)

name: NASA Exoplanet Archive
description: NASA archive of exoplanets and candidates with stellar and planetary parameters, light curves, and documented discovery information and services.

name: MAST
description: Space Telescope Science Institute archive holding data from Hubble, JWST, TESS, and other missions, with public data access and search portals.

name: Minor Planet Center
description: IAU supported center that collects observations of asteroids and comets, assigns designations, and publishes orbits and catalogs of small solar system bodies.

name: HEASARC
description: NASA archive for high energy astrophysics with X-ray and gamma ray mission data, browse tools, and standardized analysis software and services.

name: HubbleSite
description: Public site for the Hubble Space Telescope run by the Space Telescope Science Institute with news, images, science releases, and observatory facts.

name: Webb Space Telescope (JWST)
description: Public site for the James Webb Space Telescope run by the Space Telescope Science Institute with news, images, science releases, and observatory information.

name: National Vulnerability Database
description: NIST managed vulnerability database that enriches CVE records with severity metrics, affected product listings, and search and data feed services.
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

name: CVE Program
description: Official site of the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures program, providing CVE record search, identifiers, and program documentation.

name: GitHub Advisory Database
description: GitHub maintained database of security advisories for open source packages, combining reviewed entries with community and ecosystem contributed data.

name: OSV.dev
description: Open source vulnerability database and API aggregating advisories from ecosystems such as PyPI, npm, and Go into a consistent schema.

name: Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
description: CISA catalog of vulnerabilities with confirmed exploitation in the wild, listing remediation due dates and offering machine readable downloads.

name: Debian Security Tracker
description: Debian project tracker showing security status of packages across Debian releases, including open CVE issues, fixed versions, and history.

name: Ubuntu Security Notices
description: Canonical listing of Ubuntu Security Notices describing fixed vulnerabilities, affected releases, updated packages, and references.

name: Red Hat Security
description: Red Hat security resource area with advisories, CVE entries, severity ratings, and mitigation guidance for Red Hat products.
status_notes: Some linked knowledgebase articles require a Red Hat subscription.

name: Exploit Database
description: OffSec maintained public archive of exploits and vulnerable software references used by penetration testers and security researchers.

name: CERT-EU
description: Computer emergency response team for the EU institutions, publishing security advisories, threat intelligence summaries, and guidance.

name: Data.gov
description: United States federal open data catalog linking datasets, tools, and resources from federal agencies with metadata search and API access.

name: data.europa.eu
description: Official portal for European open data, aggregating datasets from EU institutions, bodies, and national catalogs of member countries.
publisher: Publications Office of the European Union

name: data.gov.uk
description: UK government open data catalog publishing datasets from central and local government bodies with search and API access.

name: data.gov.in
description: Indian government open data platform sharing datasets, catalogs, visualizations, and APIs from ministries and departments.

name: data.gov.au
description: Australian government open data catalog listing datasets from federal, state, and territory agencies with search and API access.

name: data.go.jp
description: Japanese government open data catalog that indexes datasets published by ministries and local governments across Japan.

name: datos.gob.es
description: Spanish government open data portal aggregating datasets from state administrations and autonomous communities with reuse guidance.

name: data.gouv.fr
description: French national open data platform where ministries, local authorities, and organizations publish datasets, with documented API access.

name: GovData
description: German open data portal that catalogs datasets from federal ministries, states, and municipalities in a single registry.

name: data.govt.nz
description: New Zealand government open data catalog listing datasets from public agencies with search, guidance, and API access.

name: Open Government Canada
description: Canadian open government portal combining datasets, maps, and open information from federal departments and agencies.

name: datos.gov.co
description: Colombian national open data portal publishing government datasets with search, visualizations, and machine readable access.

name: datos.gob.mx
description: Mexican federal open data portal that catalogs datasets published by government agencies with search and reuse guidance.

name: data.gov.sg
description: Singapore government open data portal providing datasets, real time APIs, and visualizations from public agencies.

name: data.gov.ie
description: Irish open data portal cataloging datasets published by public bodies across national and local government in Ireland.

name: opendata.swiss
description: Swiss open data portal cataloging datasets from the federal government, cantons, and communes in multiple languages.

name: dati.gov.it
description: Italian national open data portal indexing datasets published by public administrations and regional bodies.

name: Kaggle Datasets
description: Community dataset publishing platform with uploaded datasets, linked notebooks, and discussion forums, searchable and usable through an API.
status_notes: Each dataset carries its own licence set by the uploader.

name: data.world
description: Collaborative data catalog where users upload, query, and discuss datasets in projects, with SQL querying and an API.

name: Google Dataset Search
description: Google search service that indexes datasets across thousands of repositories using publisher supplied structured metadata.

name: Humanitarian Data Exchange
description: UN OCHA platform for sharing humanitarian operational data, hosting datasets from organizations responding to crises worldwide.
publisher: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs

name: World Bank Data Catalog
description: World Bank catalog listing open datasets, databases, and microdata collections with search across development data holdings.

name: CKAN
description: Open source data management system used by governments and organizations to power open data catalogs, with a documented API and harvesting tools.

name: Registry of Open Data on AWS
description: Amazon Web Services registry listing public datasets hosted on AWS across science, geospatial, and other domains, with access notes.

name: Microsoft Planetary Computer
description: Microsoft catalog of Earth observation and environmental datasets with open STAC access and notebook based processing tools.

name: Wayback Machine
description: Internet Archive service that captures and replays archived web pages, allowing users to view historical versions of sites over time.
status_notes: Archived page content remains under the rights of the original publishers.

name: Internet Archive
description: Nonprofit digital library offering archived websites, books, audio, video, and software collections with free public access.

name: Common Crawl
description: Nonprofit project that publishes open full web crawl datasets with URL indexes that support large scale web research.

name: UK Web Archive
description: Consortium archive of UK websites collected by the British legal deposit libraries, preserving publications that appear only on the web.
status_notes: Some archived content can be read only on legal deposit library premises.

name: Arquivo.pt
description: Portuguese web archive that preserves pages and provides search, replay, and API access to historical web content.

name: UK Government Web Archive
description: The National Archives collection of archived UK government websites, including closed departments and historical policy pages.

name: Archive-It
description: Internet Archive subscription service that lets organizations build, store, and publish curated web archive collections.

name: Conifer
description: Rhizome web archiving service for creating, browsing, and replaying archived websites through a browser based tool.
